description: PERMANENT AND PUBLIC: revoke an agent's registration. The revocation is sealed in the transparency log and apps stop trusting it; its DNS records are removed from zones on Porkbun nameservers (`manualDnsCleanup` lists any elsewhere). The name can be registered again later as a new registration. Get the user's explicit confirmation first.

agent_id.description: The agentId from register_ans_agent or list_ans_agents.

confirm.description: Must be "revoke": confirms the user agreed to a permanent, public revocation.

dry_run.description: Show which agent would be revoked, without revoking it.

reason.description: Default CESSATION_OF_OPERATION. KEY_COMPROMISE if the identity key leaked.

name: revoke_ans_agent
title: Revoke Ans Agent
